additions.name: iXAfrica NBOX1 — existing campus operations

status.summary: iXAfrica's release of 21 October 2026 reports that Workonline Communications has established a new Point of Presence at iXAfrica's NBOX1 campus on Mombasa Road, Nairobi, giving customers at iXAfrica direct access to Workonline's network (the release says they will be able to take its IP transit services directly from the NBOX1 campus), and quotes iXAfrica's chief executive that NBOX1 was built as a neutral meeting point for networks, cloud platforms, content providers and enterprises and that every network joining NBOX1 adds value 'for everyone already connected here'. This records the NBOX1 campus as operating on 21 October 2026; it is not an opening date. The operator's campus page lists NBOX1.1 (4.5 MW) as live and NBOX1.2 (18 MW) without a stated status, so only the existing operations are asserted: NBOX1.2 completion or operation is not established, and the 22.5 MW full-site figure is not load in service.

locator.precision: Google named 'iXAfrica Data Centre' marker on Mombasa Road, Nairobi, which links the operator website, used to locate the NBOX1 campus at its Mombasa Road frontage. It is not a surveyed footprint, parcel boundary, entrance or data-hall location, and it does not separate NBOX1.1 from NBOX1.2.
locator.identity_review: The release names iXAfrica Data Centres' NBOX1 campus in Nairobi; iXAfrica's campus-specs page places NBOX1 on a 4.3-acre, two-building campus along Mombasa Road, and its footer gives Cabanas, Mombasa Road. The only Google feature returned for the name query is 'iXAfrica Data Centre' on Mombasa Road (feature 0x183bc6c6a6552a1d:0xd868cf8613a4337d), and it links ixafrica.co.ke; the point comes from the feature's coordinates in the captured search response, not the query viewport. In Esri World Imagery the point sits at the road frontage of a walled compound with a large plant-roofed building, consistent with the described campus. PeeringDB's self-reported NBOX1 point, 472 m to the south-east, falls on the Cabanas interchange carriageways and is excluded. Google's 'Corporate office' category is a map label; iXAfrica names no other Nairobi facility.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The map feature publishes no surveyed horizontal accuracy and the operator publishes no coordinate or plot boundary; the imagery check is qualitative, with unknown imagery date and accuracy.
